title: How Much Is a Fitted Kitchen from Wickes?
description: How much is a fitted kitchen from Wickes? Understand typical costs, installation packages, extras, exclusions and comparing independent fitter quotes.
targetKeyword: how much is a fitted kitchen from wickes

blocks.text: If you are searching for how much is a fitted kitchen from Wickes, the final price depends on far more than the cabinet doors shown in the showroom. The size and layout of the room, worktop, appliances, flooring, plumbing, electrics, removal of the old kitchen and installation can all affect the total. As a rough guide, a typical UK complete fitted-kitchen project may cost around £8,000 to £25,000 or more, including products and fitting, but every project differs. A smaller, straightforward replacement can cost less, while a large kitchen with structural changes, premium appliances or extensive building work can cost considerably more. Get a free, no-obligation quote for accurate pricing for your own project.
What does a Wickes fitted kitchen typically cost?

The total cost of a retailer-supplied fitted kitchen is usually made up of several parts, such as furniture, doors and panels, worktops, sinks and taps, appliances, delivery and installation. Any promotions, package terms and included items should be confirmed directly in the written quotation. The price shown for kitchen furniture is not necessarily the price of a fully finished room, so check what work, products and connections are included.

items: As a rough guide, a typical UK small kitchen with standard units and laminate worktops may cost roughly £5,000 to £10,000 before all building and finishing work is included.
A typical UK mid-range fitted kitchen with more units, upgraded worktops and several integrated appliances may cost roughly £10,000 to £18,000 in total.
A larger or higher-specification kitchen, particularly with quartz or other premium worktops, may cost £18,000 to £25,000 or more.
Installation can represent several thousand pounds, depending on the number of trades, the kitchen layout and the preparation required.
Every project differs, so obtain a free, no-obligation quote for accurate pricing.

What is normally included in a Wickes installation package?

What is included in a Wickes installation package should be confirmed in the current written quotation and terms, as the scope can vary. Check whether the quote covers fitting kitchen units, worktops, appliance connections, plumbing, electrical work, removal and finishing work. Do not assume that work outside the listed scope is included.

items: Removal and disposal of existing cabinets, appliances or worktops, if specifically included.
Installation of base units, wall units, end panels, plinths, cornice and pelmets, where listed.
Worktop installation, with the method depending on the worktop material and design.
Connection of appliances, sinks, taps and waste pipes where the quotation allows for it.
Minor adjustments needed to install the new units in the planned layout, where included.
Basic making-good or finishing work only where it is clearly listed rather than assumed.

blocks.text: Common extras and exclusions to check carefully

The difference between an initial kitchen price and the final invoice can come from work outside the agreed installation scope. Your existing room may not be level, the walls may need repair, or the new layout may require services to move. A quote can also exclude items that homeowners assume are included, such as painting, flooring and waste removal. Ask for each allowance to be stated in writing, including how unforeseen problems will be handled.

items: Old kitchen removal, skip hire and disposal of rubble or packaging.
Plastering, repairing damaged walls, levelling floors and making good after removal.
Moving gas, water, waste or electrical supplies to suit a new layout.
Upgrading the consumer unit, adding circuits or carrying out electrical work beyond the stated allowance.
Structural work, such as removing a wall, installing a beam or altering a window or door opening.
Flooring, wall tiling, splashbacks, decorating and final paintwork.
Extra work caused by uneven walls, poor access, hidden leaks, damp or defective existing services.
Appliance upgrades, specialist worktops, upstands, panels, lighting and accessories not included in the original design.

blocks.text: Wickes installation versus an independent kitchen fitter

The fairest comparison is not simply a retailer's fitting figure against an independent fitter's labour price. Compare like for like: the same cabinet specification, appliances, worktop, preparation, waste removal, plumbing, electrics, tiling and decorating. An independent fitter may quote for labour only, while another quote may include products, installation and wider project coordination. An independent team may also be able to include wider renovation work under one quotation. This is why a lower initial figure is not automatically the lower finished cost.
Questions to ask before accepting either quote

items: Does the price include VAT, delivery, removal and disposal?
Who is responsible for plumbing, gas work, electrics, tiling, flooring and decorating?
Are appliance connections included, and are isolation valves, waste connections or new circuits needed?
What happens if the walls or floor are not suitable once the old kitchen is removed?
Is the worktop included, and are cut-outs, joins, upstands and edging covered?
Who manages defects, damaged items and remedial visits?
What is the payment schedule, estimated duration and process for approving variations?

faq.q: How much does a Wickes fitted kitchen cost including installation?
faq.a: As a rough guide, a typical UK complete fitted-kitchen project may cost around £8,000 to £25,000 or more, including products and fitting. Every project differs, and the final amount depends on size, specification, appliances and any building work. Get a free, no-obligation quote for accurate pricing for your project.

faq.q: Does a Wickes kitchen installation include removing the old kitchen?
faq.a: Check the current written quotation and terms. Removal, disposal and skip hire may be separate items or subject to an allowance, so they should not be assumed to be included.

faq.q: Are appliances included in a Wickes kitchen price?
faq.a: Check the written design and quotation. Appliances and their connections may be priced separately from kitchen furniture and installation, depending on the items selected and the scope quoted.

faq.q: Is it cheaper to use an independent kitchen fitter than Wickes?
faq.a: It can be, but there is no universal answer. Compare the complete scope, including preparation, plumbing, electrics, tiling, disposal, worktops and decorating, rather than labour prices alone.

faq.q: What can make a fitted kitchen quote increase?
faq.a: Common causes include moving services, repairing walls or floors, upgrading electrics, structural alterations, premium worktops, extra tiling, disposal and unforeseen problems behind the old units.
